# Settings reference

Generated from `src/hooks/useSettings.ts`, the English UI strings, and the Home Assistant add-on options in `beacon/config.yaml`. Defaults that read add-on config use the value shipped in that file.

## In-app settings

### General

| Setting | Label | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `familyName` | Family Name | `string` | My Family | Shown in the calendar header. Uses add-on option `family_name` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `saveConfigInBrowser` | Save Configuration in Browser | `boolean` | true | Keep a local browser copy of settings when the add-on allows it. Uses add-on option `save_config_in_browser` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `defaultView` | Default View | `'dashboard' / 'calendar' / 'grocery' / 'tasks' / 'music' / 'photos'` | dashboard | Screen shown at startup |
| `timeFormat` | Time Format | `'12h' / '24h'` | 12h | 12-hour or 24-hour clock. |
| `weekStartsOn` | Week Starts On | `0 / 1` | 0 | 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday. |
| `locale` | Language / Locale | `string` | en-US | Language for the interface and for formatting dates. |

### Appearance

| Setting | Label | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `themeId` | Theme | `string` | skylight | Color theme id. The in-app picker overrides the add-on option. Uses add-on option `theme` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `autoDarkMode` | Auto Dark Mode | `boolean` | true | Switch themes based on time of day. Uses add-on option `auto_dark_mode` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `darkModeStart` | Dark Mode Starts | `string` | 19:00 | Local time (HH:mm) when auto dark mode begins. |
| `darkModeEnd` | Dark Mode Ends | `string` | 06:00 | Local time (HH:mm) when auto dark mode ends. |
| `fontScale` | Font Size | `'normal' / 'large' / 'extra-large'` | normal | Adjust for viewing distance on wall displays |
| `headingFont` | Heading font | `FontSelection` | builtin: fraunces | Heading face. Defaults to Fraunces, the face Beacon shipped with. |
| `bodyFont` | Body font | `FontSelection` | builtin: inter | Body face. Defaults to Inter, the face Beacon shipped with. |
| `sidebarPosition` | Sidebar Position | `'left' / 'right' / 'bottom'` | left | Which edge the navigation sits on. |

### Calendar

| Setting | Label | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultCalendarView` | Default Calendar View | `'week' / 'month'` | week | Week or month shown when you open the calendar |
| `defaultCalendar` | Default Calendar | `string` | (empty) | Calendar selected when creating an event. |
| `permanentlyHiddenCalendars` | Hidden calendars | `string[]` | [] | Calendar ids hidden from the calendar and dashboard. |
| `calendarColors` | Calendar colors | `Record<string, string>` | {} | Chosen color for each calendar id. Overrides the automatic palette. |
| `defaultEventDuration` | Default Event Duration | `30 / 60 / 120` | 60 minutes | Length of a new timed event. |
| `notificationMinutes` | Notification Timing | `5 / 10 / 15 / 30` | 10 minutes | How long before an event Beacon notifies you. |

### Integrations

| Setting | Label | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `weatherEntity` | Weather Entity | `string` | weather.home | Entity used for weather display. Uses add-on option `weather_entity` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `grocyEnabled` | Grocy Integration | `boolean` | false | Grocery and meal planning |
| `anylistEnabled` | AnyList Integration | `boolean` | false | Shared shopping lists |
| `defaultGroceryList` | Default Grocery List | `string` | (empty) | List shown when opening grocery view |
| `groceryListIds` | Grocery Lists | `string[]` | [] | Select which HA todo entities are grocery/shopping lists |
| `shoppingEntity` | Shopping Card Entity | `string` | (empty) | HA todo list for sidebar shopping card |
| `musicDefaultPlayer` | Default Player | `string` | (empty) | Media player used by default |
| `photoDirectory` | Source Directory | `string` | /media/beacon/photos | A /media path, or any Home Assistant media-source id. Browse to pick a folder. Uses add-on option `photo_directory` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `photoInterval` | Slideshow Interval | `number` | 30 seconds | Seconds between photo changes. Uses add-on option `photo_interval` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `photoTransition` | Transition Style | `'fade' / 'slide'` | fade | How the photo frame moves between pictures. |

### Dashboard

| Setting | Label | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dashboardLayout` | Layout | `'default' / 'classic' / 'compact'` | default | Pick a preset layout |
| `advancedDashboard` | Advanced Dashboard | `boolean` | false | Enable customizable dashboard widgets and layouts |

### Display

| Setting | Label | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `screenSaverEnabled` | Screen Saver | `boolean` | true | Shows a floating clock after idle |
| `dimTimeout` | Dim After | `number` | 5 minutes | Minutes of inactivity before dimming |
| `screenSaverTimeout` | Screen Saver After | `number` | 5 minutes | Minutes before screen saver activates. Uses add-on option `screen_saver_timeout` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `alwaysOnDisplay` | Always-On Display | `boolean` | false | Prevent screen from sleeping |
| `showSeconds` | Show Seconds on Clock | `boolean` | false | Display seconds in the header clock |
| `kioskMode` | Kiosk Mode | `boolean` | false | Hide the sidebar for a cleaner display |
| `kioskRevealGesture` | Reveal navigation gesture | `boolean` | true | On by default. In kiosk mode, long-press the top corner for 2 seconds or tap it 3 times quickly to show the sidebar. Hold Escape on a keyboard. It hides again after 15 seconds of inactivity. A family PIN is required when one is set. |
| `voiceButton` | Voice button | `boolean` | true | Show hold-to-talk on the wall. On by default in the Home Assistant add-on. The mic needs HTTPS or localhost; ingress over HTTPS works, and a plain HTTP kiosk keeps the text box. |
| `magicImport` | Magic Import | `boolean` | true | Show Import on the dashboard and calendar. On by default in the Home Assistant add-on. Pasted text is processed by your Home Assistant conversation agent, or a local parser. |
| `magicImportUseHaAgent` | Magic Import: use Home Assistant conversation agent | `boolean` | true | On by default. When on, pasted text is processed by your Home Assistant conversation agent, or a local parser if that agent is unavailable. When off, Beacon always uses the local parser. Beacon itself sends the text nowhere. It stays in your home unless your Home Assistant conversation agent is a cloud service; in that case HA sends it to that provider. |

### Chores

| Setting | Label | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `choresEnabled` | Enable Chores | `boolean` | true | Show chore tracking and rewards |
| `choresResetTime` | Daily Reset Time | `string` | 00:00 | When the chore day starts (HH:mm). Privilege switches, chore-event local_date, and "what chores are left" use this same day. Unset, empty, or invalid values are treated as 00:00 (local midnight). |
| `streakDays` | Streak Duration | `number` | 7 days | Days needed to maintain a streak |
| `currencySymbol` | Currency Symbol | `string` | $ | Symbol shown beside chore rewards. |
| `payoutSchedule` | Payout Schedule | `'weekly' / 'monthly'` | weekly | How often chore earnings are totaled. |

## Family member fields

These live on each person under **Settings → Family Members**, not in the tables above. Name, avatar, color, role, PIN, and calendars are described on [Family Members](/docs/features/family/).

| Field | Label | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `privilegeEntityId` | Privilege switch | `string` (optional) | (omitted) | Children only, Beacon 1.45.0 and later. A Home Assistant `switch`, `input_boolean`, `light`, or `fan` that turns on when this child finishes today's chores. Clearing the picker removes the field. Existing members, settings, and add-on options are left unchanged. See [Chore privileges](/docs/features/chore-privileges/). |

## Add-on options

These are the options in `beacon/config.yaml`, which Home Assistant uses for the add-on. The schema type is the add-on schema.

| Option | Label | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `family_name` | Family Name | string | My Family | Shown in the calendar header. Uses add-on option `family_name` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `ha_token` | Home Assistant token | password | (empty) | Long-lived access token used for browser-side Home Assistant access. Stored as a password. |
| `save_config_in_browser` | Save Configuration in Browser | boolean | true | Keep a local browser copy of settings when the add-on allows it. Uses add-on option `save_config_in_browser` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `theme` | Theme | string | skylight | Color theme id. The in-app picker overrides the add-on option. Uses add-on option `theme` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `auto_dark_mode` | Auto Dark Mode | boolean | true | Switch themes based on time of day. Uses add-on option `auto_dark_mode` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `weather_entity` | Weather Entity | string | weather.home | Entity used for weather display. Uses add-on option `weather_entity` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `photo_directory` | Source Directory | string | /media/beacon/photos | A /media path, or any Home Assistant media-source id. Browse to pick a folder. Uses add-on option `photo_directory` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `photo_interval` | Slideshow Interval | integer | 30 | Seconds between photo changes. Uses add-on option `photo_interval` when Home Assistant provides it. |
| `screen_saver_timeout` | Screen Saver After | integer | 5 | Minutes before screen saver activates. Uses add-on option `screen_saver_timeout` when Home Assistant provides it. |
